sources.entry: wattop by Jasonm4130 - Terminal monitor for Apple Silicon Macs that shows live Claude Code and Codex sessions, including subagent and workflow trees, with output tokens/s, context fill and estimated cost beside CPU/GPU power, temperatures and fans. Reads local transcripts.

summary.one_liner: wattop is a terminal monitor for Apple Silicon Macs that shows live Claude Code and Codex sessions alongside CPU, GPU, power, temperature and fan readings.
summary.what_it_does: It lists every running Claude Code and Codex session with its status, output tokens per second, context fill, estimated cost and $/hr, bound to the CPU, GPU and memory of its process. Claude Code subagent spawns, workflow runs and Codex child threads appear as a tree, each with its own rate and cost. Alongside, it reports Apple Silicon hardware metrics: CPU/GPU/ANE/DRAM power, E- and P-cluster load, temperatures, fans, thermal pressure, memory, swap, network and disk, with two-minute history graphs. It reads IOReport and SMC directly, so it needs no sudo and no runtime dependencies. The --json flag streams one snapshot per interval as NDJSON, and --once prints one snapshot and exits. Transcripts under ~/.claude and ~/.codex are read locally and never written to.
use_cases: watch Codex agent token rate and cost
view Apple Silicon power and thermals in terminal
estimate AI coding API spend per hour
script hardware and agent snapshots as JSON
notable: Live Claude Code and Codex session monitoring bound to per-process CPU, GPU and memory
Subagent and workflow tree showing nested and background agent runs
Reads IOReport and SMC directly instead of wrapping powermetrics, so no sudo
Scriptable NDJSON output via --json and one-shot --once mode
Built-in --demo mode with synthetic data that reads nothing local
caveats: Apple Silicon only, macOS 14 or newer; no Linux or Intel build
Early-stage project; costs are API-price estimates, not subscription balances
Hardware support varies by chip and macOS version; links Apple's private IOReport framework via CGO
keywords: see what my ai agents cost
